subject.title: fix(launchd): verify profile updater jobs by metadata

question: Should maintainers accept this metadata-gated launchd classifier as safe enough to broaden stale updater reporting and disable actions for profile-scoped labels?
rationale: The code and proof support the fix, but the changed surface can affect macOS launchd availability if the metadata gate is too broad, so final risk acceptance belongs to an owner.

options.title: Land With Metadata Gate
options.body: Accept the demonstrated metadata and ProgramArguments gate as the safety boundary for profile-scoped updater labels.

options.title: Request Owner macOS Confirmation
options.body: Ask a maintainer to rerun the temporary LaunchAgent proof on macOS before merging.

options.title: Pause For Narrower Rule
options.body: Keep the PR open until the label or metadata contract is narrowed further.

recommendation.title: Land With Metadata Gate
recommendation.body: Accept the demonstrated metadata and ProgramArguments gate as the safety boundary for profile-scoped updater labels.

likelyOwner.reason: This PR is assigned to steipete and his history is closest to the launchd stale-updater and update cleanup surfaces.
